command:
set -eu
d=/tmp/user-password-hash-migration
getent passwd mira niko sana > "$d/installed-passwd"
cmp -s "$d/passwd" "$d/installed-passwd"
awk -F: '
NR==FNR { primary[$4]=1; next }
{
  include = (primary[$3] ? 1 : 0)
  n = split($4, members, ",")
  for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (members[i] == "mira" || members[i] == "niko" || members[i] == "sana") include = 1
  if (include) print
}' "$d/passwd" "$d/group" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$d/source-relevant-groups"
awk -F: '
NR==FNR { primary[$4]=1; next }
{
  include = (primary[$3] ? 1 : 0)
  n = split($4, members, ",")

  if (include) print
}' "$d/passwd" /etc/group | LC_ALL=C sort > "$d/installed-relevant-groups"
cmp -s "$d/source-relevant-groups" "$d/installed-relevant-groups"
for u in mira niko sana; do id "$u" > "$d/installed-id-$u"; cmp -s "$d/id-$u" "$d/installed-id-$u"; done

command:
set -eu
d=/tmp/user-password-hash-migration
pid=$(cat "$d/http.pid")
args=$(ps -p "$pid" -o args=)
case "$args" in
  *'python3 -m http.server 18080'*) kill "$pid"; sleep 1; ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || { printf '%s\n' 'transfer server did not stop' >&2; exit 1; } ;;
  *) printf '%s\n' "unexpected process for staging pid $pid" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
rm -f "$d/passwd" "$d/group" "$d/shadow" "$d/gshadow" "$d/id-mira" "$d/id-niko" "$d/id-sana" "$d/homes.tar" "$d/migration.tar" "$d/http.pid" "$d/http.log"
rmdir "$d"
if [ -e "$d" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'staging directory remains' >&2; exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' 'node1 temporary staging and transfer endpoint removed'
ss -tln 2>/dev/null | awk '$4 ~ /:18080$/ {print}'
